name: Zephyr T2 (zephyr + zephyr-devel)
install:
set -euo pipefail
SCRIPT=""
for c in "$PWD/.cursor/cloud-install.sh" "$PWD/zephyr-devel/.cursor/cloud-install.sh" "$PWD/repos/zephyr-devel/.cursor/cloud-install.sh" "/agent/repos/zephyr-devel/.cursor/cloud-install.sh" "/workspace/zephyr-devel/.cursor/cloud-install.sh"; do
  if [ -f "$c" ]; then SCRIPT="$c"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$SCRIPT" ]; then
  echo "cloud-install.sh not found; is zephyr-devel checked out?" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "cloud-install: running $SCRIPT"
bash "$SCRIPT"
